pages.text: Transversing a dense forest isn't always an easy task, as sometimes those campfires in the horizon doesn't mean that a village it's near, but instead a forest troll it's ahead.$(br2)They don't have the same rocky defenses as other trolls, so instead they try to counter their lack of defense wearing primitive clothing.
Even though forest troll are slightly larger than rock or ice trolls, they are the calmest of the troll's subspecies.

$(l)$(#fc5454)Behavior$()$(br)Quicker than rock or ice trolls, forest trolls favor melee combat.$(br)They sometimes block their front with thick, sturdy arms, though a well-aimed strike with a sharp axe can shatter their defense.$(br)Capable of rapid regeneration, these trolls will recover from wounds unless utterly slain.$(br2)When distant from their prey, they charge at full speed, destroying anything in their path.

Even the $(n)rabid$() breed is also present in the subspecies, though it's rare to find one.$(br)The best strategy against these monsters is to try to $(l:tcots_witcher:misc/befriending_troll)befriend$(/l) them if possible instead of engaging in combat.
